admin_settings_sms_configuration.name: admin_settings_sms_configuration
admin_settings_sms_configuration.value: ((login_method = 'password'::text) OR ((sms_provider IS NOT NULL) AND (sms_template_key IS NOT NULL)))

brand_translations_public_read.name: brand_translations_public_read
brand_translations_public_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM brands
  WHERE ((brands.id = brand_translations.brand_id) AND brands.is_published)))

cities_public_read.name: cities_public_read
cities_public_read.using:
(is_published AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (provinces p
     JOIN countries c ON ((c.id = p.country_id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = cities.province_id) AND p.is_published AND c.is_published))))

editorial_translations_public_read.name: editorial_translations_public_read
editorial_translations_public_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM editorial_entries e
  WHERE ((e.id = editorial_translations.entry_id) AND e.is_published AND (e.published_at <= now()))))

gallery_items_public_read.name: gallery_items_public_read
gallery_items_public_read.using:
(is_published AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM gallery_albums a
  WHERE ((a.id = gallery_items.album_id) AND a.is_published))))

job_applications_public_insert.name: job_applications_public_insert
job_applications_public_insert.withCheck: ((status = 'new'::text) AND (internal_note IS NULL) AND (reviewed_by IS NULL))

job_positions_public_read.name: job_positions_public_read
job_positions_public_read.using: (is_published AND (published_at <= now()) AND ((closes_at IS NULL) OR (closes_at > now())))

product_applications_public_read.name: product_applications_public_read
product_applications_public_read.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_applications.product_id) AND p.is_published))) OR ( SELECT private.has_staff_role(ARRAY['manager'::text, 'admin'::text, 'seo'::text]) AS has_staff_role))

products_public_read.name: products_public_read
products_public_read.using:
(is_published AND (published_at <= now()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM brands
  WHERE ((brands.id = products.brand_id) AND brands.is_published))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM product_categories
  WHERE ((product_categories.id = products.category_id) AND product_categories.is_published))))

profiles_manager_delete.name: profiles_manager_delete
profiles_manager_delete.using: (( SELECT private.has_staff_role(ARRAY['manager'::text]) AS has_staff_role) AND (id <> ( SELECT private.current_user_id() AS current_user_id)))

profiles_read_own.name: profiles_read_own
profiles_read_own.using: ((id = ( SELECT private.current_user_id() AS current_user_id)) OR ( SELECT private.has_staff_role(ARRAY['manager'::text]) AS has_staff_role))

provinces_public_read.name: provinces_public_read

   FROM countries c
  WHERE ((c.id = provinces.country_id) AND c.is_published))))

representatives_public_read.name: representatives_public_read
representatives_public_read.using:
(is_published AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((cities ci
     JOIN provinces p ON ((p.id = ci.province_id)))
     JOIN countries c ON ((c.id = p.country_id)))
  WHERE ((ci.id = representatives.city_id) AND ci.is_published AND p.is_published AND c.is_published))))
